City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
NOVEMBER 8, 2016
07:00
P.M.
11-8-16 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of Sunset Elementary, Workman Elementary, Sierra Vista Middle School and Sparks Middle School Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Presentation of Certificates of Recognition to Erik Perez and Mia Perez for Taekwondo Championships
Presentation of Certificates of Recognition to Main Street Run Participants
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF OCTOBER 25, 2016, AND OCTOBER 26, 2016
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of October 25, 2016, and October 26, 2016.
A-1 Minutes 10-25-16 CC-SA
A-1 Minutes 10-26-16 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING CONSTRUCTION OPTIONS FOR THE LA PUENTE PARK RESTROOM IMPROVEMENT PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council select either Option A or Option B for the La Puente Park restroom improvement project.
C-1 Park Restroom Rehab Staff Report
C-1 Park Restroom Rehab Attachment A - Proposed Elevation
C-1 Park Restroom Rehab Attachment B Portland Loo
C-1 Park Restroom Rehab Attachment C Cost Options
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1418
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 16-5312 approving Warrant Register No. 1418.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1418
D-2
PRESENTATION OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTEâ€™S STRATEGIC PLAN SIX-MONTH OBJECTIVES
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report.
D-2 Strategic Plan Staff Report
D-2 Strategic Plan Attachment A Objectives
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION GRANTING A FEE WAIVER FOR THE LA PUENTE YOUTH COALITION'S USE OF LA PUENTE PARK FOR A COMMUNITY CARNIVAL
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5313 approving a request for a fee waiver for the Youth Coalition's Carnival.
D-3 Youth Coalition Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-3 Youth Coalition Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-3 Youth Coalition Fee Waiver Attachment B Proposal
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION NOMINATING A BOARD MEMBER TO THE SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5314 nominating a Board Member to the San Gabriel Basin Water Quality Authority.
E-1 WQA Board Member Staff Report
E-1 WQA Board Member Attachment A Letter
E-1 WQA Board Member Attachment B Resolution
E-2
INTRODUCTION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 2.04.020 (COUNCIL MEETINGS) OF CHAPTER 2.04 (CITY COUNCIL) OF TITLE 2 (ADMINISTRATION) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE, CHANGING THE METHOD OF SETTING THE DATE AND TIME OF REGULAR MEETINGS OF THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL; AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING ANY PRIOR RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING THE DATE AND TIME OF REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS, AND SETTING THE DATE AND TIME OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) waive reading of Ordinance No. 16-943 and read by title only; (2) introduce Ordinance No. 16-943 an ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente, amending Section 2.04.020 (Council Meetings) of Chapter 2.04 (City Council) of Title 2 (Administration) of the La Puente Municipal Code, changing the method of setting the date and time of regular meetings of the La Puente City Council; and (3) adopt Resolution No. 16-5315 establishing the date and time of regular City Council meetings, and setting the date and time of the regular meetings of the City Council.
E-2 Council Meeting Dates Staff Report
E-2 Council Meeting Dates Attachment A Ordinance
E-2 Council Meeting Dates Attachment B Resolution
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION

Dated this this 3rd day of November, 2016
